assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.greeting: Hi, I'm your assistant. How can I help?

hints.ADMIN: I can look up the class hours of the teachers of a subject in a month.
hints.STUDENT: I can look up your grades, your averages and the details of an evaluation.
hints.OTHER: I can't look up your data on the platform yet, but I can help with general questions.

ADMIN: How many class hours do the teachers have this month?
STUDENT: What is my average in each subject?
OTHER: What can you help me with?

assistant.disclaimer: Answers are generated automatically and may contain mistakes.
